# GIFT City Funds

> Educational resource on GIFT City and IFSC mutual fund frameworks by Anup Vatyani (MFD ARN 106715). Informational only — not investment advice.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of GIFT City IFSC investment information.
- [About GIFT City](/about): Background on India's IFSC and the IFSCA regulator.
- [Investment Structures](/investments): Educational overview of fund categories under IFSCA.
- [Resources](/resources): Featured learning articles and official references.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact and contributor information.
